name: npc-blackrock-robe
source: The Blackrock Cult Room robed figure (19 Nov 2026): a full-length black hooded robe, a deep hood that hides the face completely, long sleeves over the hands, a dark cord belt. Meshy text-to-image nano-banana-pro concept, image-to-3d, remesh 30k and auto-rig (1.78 m) on the owner's Meshy account; prepared by prepare_meshy.py. Instanced seven times in the cult room (blackrock-cult.js).
